findings.message: The declared payload checks require proving that commit_command mirrors candidate_command even when candidate_ok is low, but commit_command and commit_valid are not declared observations. The command_commit event exposes commit_command only when commit_valid is already high, so it cannot distinguish an incorrect blocked or invalid commit payload from the required mirror behavior. Add bound observations for command_engine.commit_command and command_engine.commit_valid, and include them in the payload checks that claim this behavior.

cmd_ready is required to represent first-command diagnostic readiness only while the engine is idle and cleanup/refresh permit it, but the declared command-engine combinational dependencies for probe_valid and execution_ready name only refresh state (and probe_ok for execution_ready). The contract does not explicitly connect active ownership, an occupied candidate slot, or cleanup reservation to the diagnostic gate. This leaves a compliant-looking implementation able to assert cmd_ready while active work, a held candidate, or cleanup is present. Define the idle, candidate-slot, and cleanup gating conditions for probe_valid/execution_ready and declare their relevant dependencies so the diagnostic behavior is implementable and reviewable.

The package explicitly records that authoritative provenance and acceptance of the selected DDR4-3200 timing-library source requires external review and blocks design review. Timing permissions, refresh cadence, and all exact-boundary expectations depend on that external acceptance. Resolve or explicitly obtain the required external timing-library provenance/acceptance before RTL generation; this cannot be established by compilation or the planned checks alone.
